title: fix-bc7-rgba32-guard-cache-write
userStory: As a player, I want the game to load without ArgumentException errors and have atlas cache files actually appear on disk, so that the BC7 optimization works correctly on first load.
background: Two related bugs sharing the same root cause. (1) On savegame load: WETextureAtlas.Apply() calls CompressToBC7() on textures created via Texture2D.LoadImage() which may change the format away from RGBA32, causing ArgumentException. (2) Cache files never written: WriteBC7CacheAndReplaceTextures() in RegisterLocalAtlas is caught by its try-catch because CompressToBC7 throws the same RGBA32 exception for PNG-loaded textures (WEAtlasLoadingUtils may return non-RGBA32 Texture2Ds). In both cases the fix is to make CompressToBC7 tolerate non-RGBA32 input by creating a temporary RGBA32 copy. Look at logs for more information.
implementationNotes: In WEAtlasBC7Utils.CompressToBC7: before the unsafe block, check source.format != TextureFormat.RGBA32. If not RGBA32, create a temp = new Texture2D(w, h, RGBA32, false), use Graphics.CopyTexture or temp.SetPixels(source.MakeReadable(out ...).GetPixels()), compress from temp, then Destroy(temp). Do NOT throw — just convert. Tests will be [Ignore] due to game runtime requirement.
dod: CompressToBC7 does not throw when source texture is not RGBA32
CompressToBC7 converts source to RGBA32 before compressing
Game loads existing savegame without ArgumentException in Apply()
After LoadImagesFromLocalFoldersCoroutine runs, .cache.we.bc7 files appear in the cache folder
